nationality: 宋（徽州婺源，生于福建尤溪）
intellectual_tradition: 理学集大成（闽学），综合周敦颐、张载、二程而融铸为理本论体系
historical_significance: 朱熹（1130—1200），字元晦，号晦庵，徽州婺源人，南宋理学集大成者。历仕高宗至宁宗四朝，仕途短暂而讲学不辍：重建白鹿洞书院、创立武夷精舍与考亭书院，门生遍天下。他以'理一分殊'立本体总纲，以'格物致知'立认识与工夫论枢纽，以'居敬穷理'立修养双轮，首次将《大学》《中庸》《论语》《孟子》并列为'四书'并作《章句集注》——元以后定为科举官学，支配东亚思想六百年。其学问横跨哲学、经学、史学、文学、天文、历法、音律，是前现代世界罕见的百科全书式体系建构者。
core_thoughts: 理一分殊（本体论：万物各具一理，万理同出一原）
理气不离不杂（形上形下的双层实在结构）
格物致知（认识论：即物穷理，至于贯通）
居敬穷理（工夫论：主敬涵养与穷理致知互为双轮）
心统性情（心性论：心为主宰，性为体、情为用）
知行相须（论先后知为先，论轻重行为重）
famous_quote: 问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来（《观书有感》）；即物而穷其理也（《大学章句·格物补传》）
influence: 朱熹以六十余年著述与讲学，把北宋五子的分散洞见整合为一个可教学、可考试、可传承的完整体系：《四书章句集注》自元代起为科举定本，'格物致知'成为东亚读书人的共同认识论程序。其学东传朝鲜（李退溪、李栗谷）、日本（朱子学为幕府官学），深刻塑造东亚近代化之前的整个知识秩序。庆元党禁时其学被斥为'伪学'，身后却配享孔庙，从祀地位仅次于孔子，故有'非朱子之传义不敢言'之语；同时其'即物穷理'的命题也被王阳明格竹失败所反转，引出阳明心学的三百年论辩——一个体系的重要性，往往由反对者的体系规模来度量。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说解》：'自其本而之末，则一理之实，而万物分之以以为体。故万物之中，各有一太极。'——月印万川：一理在万物中的整体分有。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: In his commentary: 'From root to branch, one principle is real, and all things each take a share of it as their constitution—thus every thing contains a Taiji.' The one principle wholly present in each of the many, like one moon mirrored in ten thousand rivers.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《答黄道夫》：'理也者，形而上之道也，生物之本也；气也者，形而下之器也，生物之具也。'——理气'不离不杂'：双层实在结构。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Li is the formless Way, the root of generation; qi is the formed vessel, the material of generation.' Li and qi are never separated yet never confused—a two-tier realist structure.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《大学章句·格物补传》：'即物而穷其理……至于用力之久，而一旦豁然贯通焉。'——从逐一穷理到豁然贯通的积累-跃迁认识论。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Go to things and exhaust their principles… after long effort, one day a sudden breakthrough connects everything.' An accumulation-then-insight epistemology: exhaustive item-by-item inquiry culminating in integration.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《朱子语类》：'未有天地之先，毕竟也只是理。有此理，便有此天地。'——以逻辑在先而非时间在先论证理的优先性。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Before heaven and earth existed, there was after all only li. Where there is this li, there is this heaven-and-earth.' Li is prior in logical order, not in time.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 程颐'涵养须用敬，进学则在致知'为朱子终身持守：'敬字工夫，乃圣门第一义，彻头彻尾，不可顷刻间断'——主敬与穷理互为双轮。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Holding Cheng Yi's dictum for life: 'Cultivation requires reverence; learning advances through extending knowledge.' Reverence and inquiry as two wheels of one cart—neither may pause.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《答张钦夫》诸书论'心统性情'：'性是体，情是用，心是统贯体用的主宰。'心以性为体、以情为用而主宰之——把心理结构化为体-用-主宰三层。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Nature is the substance, feeling the function, and mind the master that integrates both.' A three-tier model of the psyche: mind as governing center over essence and expression.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《语类》：'论先后，知为先；论轻重，行为重。''知行常相须，如目无足不行，足无目不见。'——知行互须而行为重的次序论。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'In order, knowledge comes first; in weight, action matters more.' Knowledge and action are mutually dependent, as the eye and the foot—neither works alone.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《观书有感》：'半亩方塘一鉴开，天光云影共徘徊。问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来。'——以水喻心，认知系统的清明在于持续输入新知。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The half-acre pond poem: 'Why is the water so clear? Because fresh water keeps flowing from the source.' The mind stays clear only through continuous inflow of new learning.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 重修白鹿洞书院并手订《白鹿洞书院揭示》：五教之目、为学之序、修身处事接物之要——把教育目标、课程次第与行为规范做成可复制的制度文本。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: His Academy Statutes for White Deer Grotto: objectives of teaching, sequence of learning, norms of conduct—a replicable institutional text that became the template for East Asian academies.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《四书章句集注》以毕生修改（临终前三日犹改《大学》诚意章注）；《近思录》把北宋四子语录剪裁为十四卷进学阶梯——经典的筛选、排序与再结构化本身即是方法论。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: He revised the Four Books commentary until three days before his death, and curated Near Reflections as a fourteen-chapter ladder into the masters—selection, ordering, and restructuring of the canon as a method in itself.

cross_references.description_zh: 周敦颐以二百余字《太极图说》立理学总纲而语焉不详；朱熹作《太极图说解》《通书解》，将'无极而太极'训释为'无形而有理'，把濂溪的极简图式接引为可论证的理本论——朱子的注释工作使周敦颐从一位地方官上升为理学开山。奠基者提供问题框架，体系化者提供论证文本，二者共同构成理学的'宪法与司法解释'结构。
cross_references.description_en: Zhou Dunyi supplied the terse founding text; Zhu Xi's commentaries glossed 'Wuji and yet Taiji' as 'formless yet possessing li,' converting the diagram into an arguable li-ontology. The founder frames questions; the systematizer provides the argumentative text—together they form Neo-Confucianism's constitution and case law.

cross_references.description_zh: 张载以'太虚即气'立气一元论，其《西铭》'民吾同胞，物吾与也'被朱熹收入《近思录》首卷而高度推崇；但朱熹以'理气不离不杂'重构气的地位——气是被理所统摄的形下之具。朱子吸收关学的道德气象与工夫语汇，却在本体论上把张载的气本论改写为理本论的一个层次。
cross_references.description_en: Zhu Xi canonized Zhang Zai's Western Inscription in Near Reflections while recasting his qi-monism: qi becomes the formed instrument governed by li. Zhu absorbed Guanxue's moral ethos yet subordinated its ontology within li-idealism.

cross_references.description_zh: 王弼以《老子注》《周易注》确立'得意忘言'的注释传统——通过注经建立自家体系而不自立名目；朱熹承其以注为著之径（《四书章句集注》），却翻转其玄学方向：王弶注经以会通道家，朱子注经以重建儒家第一原理。二人共同证明：体系革命的最高形态往往以'注释'的名义完成。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Bi founded the tradition of building one's own system through commentary; Zhu Xi inherited the exegetical vehicle (Four Books commentary) but reversed its direction—from Daoist synthesis to Confucian first principles. Both prove: the deepest revolutions arrive disguised as annotations.

modern_value_zh: 格物致知程序——'即物穷理→积累→豁然贯通'是最早的'数据积累驱动涌现式洞察'的认识论表述，直接先于近代实证方法
理一分殊——普遍原理与具体情境的双向结构，是'统一理论+领域特化'的古典模型（月印万川：同一月亮，万川各印）
居敬穷理双轮——态度修养（敬）与知识探究（穷理）互为条件，对治'只刷课不修炼'或'只修炼不学习'的单轮失衡
知行相须而行为重——'论先后知为先，论轻重行为重'：先学后做，但评价只看做。知识管理的黄金次序
制度化的知识工程——白鹿洞学规+四书体系+书院讲会：把个人洞见转化为可复制、可考核、可传承的制度文本，是知识体系建设的完整原型
modern_value_en: The gewu procedure: exhaustive inquiry → accumulation → breakthrough insight—an early epistemology of emergence from data, preceding modern empiricism
Li-one, diversities-particular: universal principle plus domain specialization—the classical 'unified theory + local adaptation' model, as one moon mirrored in ten thousand rivers
Twin wheels of reverence and inquiry: attitude cultivation and knowledge pursuit as mutual conditions—the antidote to one-wheeled learning
Order of knowing, weight of doing: learn before acting, but be judged by action alone—the golden sequence of knowledge management
Institutional knowledge engineering: academy statutes, canon selection, lecture associations—a complete prototype for turning personal insight into replicable, examinable, transmissible institutions
place_of_origin: 徽州婺源（今江西婺源），生于福建尤溪
unique_thing: 朱熹的核心成就是一次'体系集成工程'：他不是任何单一观念的原创者（理出自二程、气出自张载、图式出自周敦颐、格物出自《大学》），却以六十年之功把散落的洞见焊接为历史上最完整、最可教学的东方思想体系——并配上注释、书院、学规、考试四件套，使其在死后六百年间成为整个东亚的默认操作系统。他证明：集成的意义不亚于原创；给人类的知识组件配上一套完整的'安装程序与运行环境'，其历史杠杆率可能超过发明任何一个组件本身。
